title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: intractable
text:
intractable
intractable
(definition)
Definition:
A problem for which no
algorithm
can exist which computes all instances of it in
polynomial time
.
See also
tractable
,
undecidable problem
,
unsolvable problem
.

PEB
